FAQ

Everything You Wanted To Know

How long does setup take at the event?

Setup takes about 30–45 minutes. Our crew arrives ahead of time so the booth is ready and running before your first guests walk in.

Do you need power or internet on site?

A standard power outlet near the booth is all we need. For QR sharing and cloud uploads we bring our own cellular hotspot, so we're never dependent on the venue's WiFi.

How many guests can the booth handle per hour?

On average the booth prints dozens of photos an hour, depending on group sizes. We're happy to add extra stations to match your expected guest count so lines stay short.

Can the booth match our event's design?

Absolutely. Frames, colors and on-screen stickers can be fully customized to your event's name and date, and VIP packages include a custom-designed booth as well.

What happens to the photos after the event?

Every photo is backed up automatically to the cloud. Within 48 hours you'll get a link to the full event album, free to download and share with every guest.
